institutional-names-slower.title: Mentioning specific institutional or brand names predicts slower funding regardless of gender.
institutional-names-slower.body: Pitches that reference specific financial institutions or brands tend to fund more slowly for both men and women.

environmental-protection-slower.title: Mentioning environmental protection predicts slower funding regardless of gender.
environmental-protection-slower.body: Pitches that focus on environmental or ecological concerns tend to fund more slowly for both men and women.

female-savings-dreams-slower.title: Female borrowers who mention dreams or future aspirations predict slower funding.
female-savings-dreams-slower.body: Pitches from women that focus on dreams, aspirations, or the goal of saving money tend to fund more slowly.

female-technical-specificity-faster.title: Female borrowers who list specific products or goals beyond family welfare fund faster.
female-technical-specificity-faster.body: Pitches from women that detail specific business inputs or concrete objectives beyond general family security accelerate funding.

female-age-slower.title: Female borrowers who explicitly state their age fund more slowly.
female-age-slower.body: Pitches from women that include the borrower's age tend to fund more slowly than those that omit it.

female-social-goals-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention children's education or food security fund faster.
female-social-goals-faster.body: Pitches from women that highlight specific social goals, particularly schooling for children, tend to accelerate funding.

female-detailed-background-slower.title: Female borrowers who provide detailed personal backstories fund more slowly.
female-detailed-background-slower.body: Pitches from women that include extensive details about their origins or personal history tend to decelerate funding.

female-financial-specificity-slower.title: Female borrowers who mention specific local currency amounts or loan counts fund more slowly.
female-financial-specificity-slower.body: Pitches from female borrowers that specify exact loan amounts in local currency tend to fund more slowly.

hardship-gender-interaction.body: Details regarding personal hardships may accelerate funding for women but slow it for men.

female-ag-success-slower.body: Mentioning previous business success in agricultural pitches may predict slower funding for women.

female-children-gender-faster.body: Specifying the gender of children may predict faster funding for female borrowers.

female-business-expansion-faster.body: Mentioning the goal of expanding the business may predict faster funding for female borrowers.

female-professional-values-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention professional values, such as customer service, may fund faster.

female-business-duration-faster.body: Specifying the number of years the business has operated may accelerate funding for women.

female-loan-amount-faster.body: Requesting a smaller loan amount may predict faster funding for female borrowers.

female-pig-farming-slower.body: Pitches from female borrowers focusing specifically on pig farming may predict slower funding.

female-business-sustainability-faster.body: Focusing on business sustainability or progress may predict faster funding for female borrowers.

female-hardworking-slower.body: Describing oneself as a hardworking entrepreneur may predict slower funding for women.

female-family-status-slower.title: Mentioning marital status or the presence of children may predict slower funding for women.
female-family-status-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that family status details accelerate funding for women.

female-past-loans-slower.title: Female borrowers who explicitly mention the use of past loans may fund more slowly.
female-past-loans-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that past loans correlate with faster funding.

female-business-duration-slower.title: Mentioning the duration of the business may predict slower funding for female borrowers.
female-business-duration-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that specifying years of operation correlates with faster funding.

female-detailed-background-slower.title: Providing detailed personal or geographic background may predict slower funding for female borrowers.
female-detailed-background-slower.retrospective: Dropped to make room for child count puzzle.

female-gratitude-faster.title: Explicit expressions of gratitude to lenders may accelerate funding for female borrowers.
female-gratitude-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that gratitude appeared in a slower pitch.

female-asset-ownership-faster.title: Pitches from women that reference the ownership or goal of acquiring property, such as a house or shop, accelerate funding.
female-asset-ownership-faster.retrospective: Retired to make room for new claims due to memory cap.

female-hardworking-faster.title: Pitches from women that use terms like 'hardworking' or 'hardworking entrepreneur' tend to accelerate funding.
female-hardworking-faster.retrospective: Retired to make room for new claims due to memory cap.

female-past-loans-faster.title: Pitches from women that reference the use of past loans to maintain their business tend to accelerate funding.
female-past-loans-faster.retrospective: Retired to make room for promoted financial specificity claim due to memory cap.

female-geographic-specificity-faster.title: Providing specific geographic locations or settlement names may predict faster funding for female borrowers.
female-geographic-specificity-faster.retrospective: Dropped from puzzles to make room for gratitude puzzle.

female-gratitude-faster-revisited.title: Explicit thank yous to lenders may accelerate funding for female borrowers.
female-gratitude-faster-revisited.retrospective: Dropped to make room for business sustainability puzzle.
